header.userPrompt:
Implement the run event log specified in docs/plans/run-event-log/specification.md, as decided in adr/0025-run-event-log.md. Read both in full first; they are the source of truth.

Goal: replace orca's per-run and per-attempt cache files (`.orca/cache/runs/<key>.sessions.json`, `.orca/cache/attempts/<id>.manifest.json`, `<id>.cost.jsonl`) with one append-only JSONL event log per run at `.orca/cache/runs/<key>/events.jsonl`, with per-attempt trace logs moved to `.orca/cache/runs/<key>/<attemptId>.trace.log`. The committed progress log (`.orca/runs/<key>.progress.json`) is unchanged.

Acceptance criteria (details in the spec):
- Every event type and field in the spec's Events table is written, with the stated encoding (`type` = case name, `at`, `attempt` on every line; full stage paths; `schema: 1` on AttemptStarted; optional fields optional).
- Writing: an immutable in-memory projection held in a single `var` by an Ox actor (reads and updates via `ask`); a second actor appends to the file via `tell`. Neither actor throws (log and swallow). `finish` writes AttemptFinished and waits for the appender's queue to drain, on success and failure. Success teardown writes RunSucceeded instead of deleting session records.
- `SessionStore` keeps `records()` and `upsert` backed by the projection (session events after the last RunSucceeded); `upsert` no longer takes `WorkspaceWrite`; `path` and `discard()` are removed.
- Readers skip undecodable lines and unknown event types.
- Shell: `ManifestReader` becomes an event-log reader producing the values `SessionIndex`, `SessionPicker`, `ResumeCommand`, `SessionRef` and `continue --list --json` use today; sessions deduplicated by (backend, conversationKey) in first-seen order; menu redraw and WorktreeScan ranking as the spec describes.
- Pruning per run directory as the spec describes (never the current run, never a run with SessionMinted after its last RunSucceeded; newest 20 with sessions + newest 20 of any kind; trace logs of the newest 20 attempts in the current run's directory). The first attempt deletes a leftover `.orca/cache/attempts/` and `.orca/cache/runs/*.sessions.json`.
- Startup banner prints the progress log, event log and trace log paths.
- Remove the old manifest/cost-log/session-store file code and its tests; add tests for the new writer, projections, reader, pruning and banner.
- Documentation updated as listed in the spec's Documentation section (docs/using/output-and-files.md with the event table and jq cost example, AGENTS.md persisted-state table and vocabulary, docs/glossary/developers.md, amendments to ADR 0018 and ADR 0021 pointing to ADR 0025, code comments naming old paths). Set ADR 0025's status to Accepted.
- Do not post anything to GitHub issue #290.

Follow AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md conventions (build/test commands, run/attempt vocabulary, comment style). Load the `direct-style-scala` skill before writing Scala. Prefer Ox actors and immutable data over other forms of shared mutable state. No on-disk compatibility with older cache files is owed.

resultJson.description:
Replace orca's three per-run/per-attempt cache files (`.orca/cache/runs/<key>.sessions.json`, `.orca/cache/attempts/<id>.manifest.json`, `<id>.cost.jsonl`) with one append-only JSONL event log per run at `.orca/cache/runs/<key>/events.jsonl`, and move each attempt's trace log beside it (`<key>/<attemptId>.trace.log`). The committed progress log is untouched. This is ADR 0025 (adr/0025-run-event-log.md), specified in docs/plans/run-event-log/specification.md; both are the source of truth and every acceptance criterion in the task prompt maps to a line there. The motivation is issue #290: external tools want a run's cost and state, and today nothing links an attempt to its run and each file has its own lifecycle and pruning rule. One file per run, with `attempt` on every line and a `RunSucceeded` boundary event, gives a public, additive-only format (`schema: 1` on `AttemptStarted`) that a single `jq` can fold.

Inside orca the log has two roles. For the run it is the session store: at attempt start the writer loads the file into an immutable projection held by an Ox actor (reads and updates via `ask`), and a second actor appends events via `tell`; `SessionStore.records()`/`upsert` are served from that projection (session events after the last `RunSucceeded`), `upsert` drops `WorkspaceWrite`, `path`/`discard()` go away, and success teardown appends `RunSucceeded` instead of deleting a file. For the shell it replaces the attempt manifest: `ManifestReader` becomes an event-log reader producing the same values `SessionIndex`, `SessionPicker`, `ResumeCommand`, `SessionRef` and `continue --list --json` consume today, with sessions deduplicated by (backend, conversationKey) in first-seen order; the menu redraw reads only what it needs newest-first and stops early, and `WorktreeScan` ranks by the newest `events.jsonl` mtime. Pruning works on run directories (never the current run, never a run with a `SessionMinted` after its last `RunSucceeded`; newest 20 with sessions plus newest 20 of any kind; trace logs of the newest 20 attempts in the current run's directory), and the first attempt of the new version deletes the leftover `attempts/` directory and `*.sessions.json` files. No compatibility with old cache files is owed. The old manifest/cost-log/session-store code and tests are removed, docs/AGENTS/glossary/ADR amendments updated, and ADR 0025 set to Accepted. Nothing is posted to issue #290.

tasks.title: Event model, codec and line reader in orca.runlog
tasks.description: In the flow module add package `orca.runlog` with the `RunEvent` enum (every case and field from the spec's Events table, common `at: Instant` and `attempt: AttemptId`, `RunEvent.Schema = 1`), `AttemptOutcome` (moved from `orca.runner.manifest`; update that import so runner still compiles) and `TurnUsage` (today's `CostLogUsage`, same fields), plus `RunEventReader` (`read(path)` skipping undecodable lines and unknown `type`s, empty for an absent or unreadable file; a cheaper read that filters by `type` before full decode for the shell's menu). Add a `JsonValueCodec[AttemptId]` inside `object AttemptId` (tools). Codec rules: discriminator field `type` with the case name; `stage` fields encode via `StagePath.codec` (full path array); `StageOutcome`/`AttemptOutcome` as bare strings via explicit string codecs; `Cost`/`CostBasis` nested as today's cost log; optional fields may be absent or null; unknown fields ignored. Tests (`flow/src/test/scala/orca/runlog/`): one round-trip per event case pinning the JSON shape (`type`, `at`, `attempt`, `schema`, stage array encoding, bare-string outcomes), reader skips a torn last line and an unknown-type line while keeping the rest, tolerates an extra field, returns Nil for absent/unreadable; port CostLogTest's pin that `TurnUsage`'s field list equals `Usage`'s token axes. Old manifest/cost code stays untouched in this task.

tasks.title: OrcaDir run-directory paths, trace log under the run dir, three-path banner
tasks.description: Extend `OrcaDir` (tools) with `cacheRunsPath` (public, passive), `runDirPath(workDir, key)`, `ensureRunDir(workDir, key)` (creates `.orca/cache/runs/<key>/` with the cache markers, symlink-refusing), `EventLogName`/`eventLogPath(workDir, key)`, and move `traceLogPath`/`traceLogRollPattern` to `(workDir, key, id)` under the run dir; keep the old manifest/cost/attempts helpers for now (later tasks delete them). Change `OrcaLog.start(workDir, key, id)` to ensure the run dir and write the trace there, and `OrcaBanner.print` to take the progress-log path, the event-log path and the optional trace path and print the spec's `Orca <version>` + `progress:`/`events:`/`trace:` lines. tasks.title: Session projection and run-directory pruning
tasks.description: Add `orca.runlog.SessionProjection.records(events): List[SessionRecord]` (only `SessionMinted`/`SessionWireId` after the last `RunSucceeded`; latest record per `SessionKey` in mint order; `SessionWireId` applies to the record with that `id`; an unknown id is ignored) and `orca.runlog.RunPruning` with `pruneRuns(cacheRuns, current)` (never the current run's directory; never a run with a `SessionMinted` after its last `RunSucceeded`; of the rest keep the newest 20 directories that recorded any `SessionMinted` plus the newest 20 of any kind, by `events.jsonl` mtime; delete whole directories; a directory without `events.jsonl` sorts oldest; every delete guarded), `pruneTraces(runDir)` (keep rolled parts included of the newest 20 attempt ids by `OrcaDir.attemptIdOf`, delete the rest, which also removes traces of attempts that died before `AttemptStarted`) and `removeLegacy(cache)` (deletes `.orca/cache/attempts/` recursively and `.orca/cache/runs/*.sessions.json`, guarded). Tests: projection folds (boundary resets, wire-id write-back, replacement by key, order), each pruning rule with seeded directories written through the `RunEvent` codec (current kept, resumable run kept, 20+20 union, undecodable file treated as having no sessions, trace cap and rolled parts), legacy cleanup leaves the new layout alone.

tasks.title: RunEventLog writer: projection actor plus appender actor
tasks.description: Implement `orca.runlog.RunEventLog` per the brief's target layout: `trait RunEventLog extends OrcaListener` with `records()`, `upsert(record)`, `runSucceeded(branch, published)`, `finish(outcome)`, and `RunEventLog.start(workDir, runKey, attemptId, orcaVersion, flowName, tracePath, clock)(using Ox, BufferCapacity)`. Start ensures the run dir, runs `removeLegacy`, `pruneRuns`, `pruneTraces`, loads the projection via `RunEventReader` + `SessionProjection`, then appends `AttemptStarted` (`schema`, `orcaVersion`, `flow`, `workDir`, `pid`, `trace`). One actor owns the immutable projection in a single `var` (session records, open-stage stack from `StageStarted`/`StageEnded`, attempt id, clock); every read and update is an `ask`; after each update it hands the event to the appender actor with `tell`; the appender does `os.write.append` on `eventLogPath`. `onEvent` maps `StageStarted`, `StageEnded`, `BranchBound`, `SessionCommitted` (with `conversationKey`, `minted`, innermost open `stage`) and `TokensUsed` (→ `Turn`) and ignores other events; `upsert` emits `SessionMinted` for a new key (plus `SessionWireId` when the record already carries one) and `SessionWireId` when only the wire id changed; `finish` appends `AttemptFinished` then drains the appender with an `ask`. Neither actor throws: every handler logs and swallows `NonFatal`. Do not implement `SessionStore` yet (that trait changes in the next task). Tests (`RunEventLogTest`, inside `supervised`): file starts with `AttemptStarted` carrying `schema: 1`; events land in emission order with full stage paths; `SessionCommitted` and `Turn` carry the innermost open stage and none outside a stage; `upsert` write-back semantics; `records()` reflects an earlier upsert; a pre-existing log is loaded and a `RunSucceeded` boundary hides older sessions; `finish` writes `AttemptFinished` and the file is complete when it returns; an unwritable path neither throws from `onEvent`/`finish` nor stops later asks; legacy files are removed at start.

Delete `AttemptManifestWriter.scala`, `CostLog.scala`, `AttemptPruning.scala`, `AttemptManifestWriterTest`, `CostLogTest` (keep `AttemptManifest.scala`'s types for the shell until the shell task). ## Ground rules
- Read adr/0025-run-event-log.md and docs/plans/run-event-log/specification.md in full before any task; they are authoritative (event table, encodings, writer/reader/pruning/shell/banner rules). Invoke the `direct-style-scala` skill before writing Scala. Follow AGENTS.md "Conventions" (braceless syntax, explicit return types on public members, no `var` outside an Ox actor's state, no default values on persisted fields, comments are present-tense facts without history or plan labels, tests target one scenario each) and `.orca/reviewers/orca.md`. The single projection `var` is mandated by ADR 0025 (the alternatives are recorded there), so cite the ADR rather than re-running the mutable-state research CLAUDE.md asks for.
- Build/test: `sbt compile`, `sbt test`, `sbt "flow/testOnly *Foo*"`, `sbt scalafmtAll` before finishing; never `sbt clean`. Modules: tools → flow → runner → shell (build.sbt). runner tests see `tools % test->test` but NOT flow's test sources; shell tests see tools' test sources only.
- Vocabulary: run = one prompt across processes (`RunKey`, `orca.RunKey.of(prompt)`, 12 hex); attempt = one process (`AttemptId`, `tools/src/main/scala/orca/AttemptId.scala`: `<epoch ms>-<pid>`, `.startedAt`, `.pid`, `.value`, `AttemptId.parse`). Never call a process a run.
- Every `.orca/` write goes through `OrcaDir` (`tools/src/main/scala/orca/OrcaDir.scala`): directories via an `ensure*` accessor (symlink-refusing), appends with `os.write.append` inside such a directory, whole-file writes via `OrcaDir.OrcaFile.replace`. Read-side paths are passive (`*Path`) and must not create `.orca`. `OrcaDir.assertNoOrcaSymlinks(workDir, dir)` is the read-side guard the shell uses.
- Do not post to GitHub issue #290.

## Existing code being replaced (read before touching)
- `flow/src/main/scala/orca/sessions/SessionStore.scala`: trait (`path`, `records()`, `upsert(record)(using WorkspaceWrite)`, `discard()(using WorkspaceWrite)`), `OsSessionStore` over `OrcaDir.sessionRecordsPath`, codec with `withTransientNone(false)`. `SessionRecord` (`flow/.../sessions/SessionRecord.scala`): `name, stage: StagePath, id, seed, resumeWireId: Option[String], backend: BackendTag`, `.key: SessionKey`.
- `flow/src/main/scala/orca/Session.scala`: the three store call sites. `resolveSessionId`/`effectivePrompt`/`persistResumeWireId` call `fc.sessionStore.records()`; `mintSession` self-mints `given WorkspaceWrite = RuntimeInStage.workspaceToken()` only for `upsert`; `persistResumeWireId` upserts `record.copy(resumeWireId = Some(wire))` only when it differs. `FlowControl.sessionStore: SessionStore` (`flow/.../FlowControl.scala`), `DefaultFlowControl(progressStore, sessionStore, startingCommit)` (runner), `TestFlowControl` (flow tests) mirror it.
- `runner/src/main/scala/orca/runner/manifest/`: `AttemptManifest.scala` (types `AttemptStatus`, `SessionKind`, `ManifestSession(backend, wireId, agent, role, stage: Option[String], minted: Option[SessionKey], lastActiveAt)`, `AttemptManifest(orcaVersion, flow, workDir, branch, pid, startedAt, finishedAt, status, sessions)` with `continuable`), `AttemptManifestWriter.scala` (`AttemptOutcome` enum; `start(workDir, orcaVersion, flowName, attemptId, clock)(using Ox, BufferCapacity)`; actor-backed listener; `ManifestState` pure transitions: stage stack from `StageStarted`/`StageEnded`, `withSession` upsert by `(backend, OrcaEvent.conversationKey(clientId, wireId))` keeping `minted` once seen; `guarded` log-and-swallow), `CostLog.scala` (`CostLogUsage` mirror of `Usage` token axes, `CostRecord.of(t: TokensUsed, at, stage)`), `AttemptPruning.scala` (`keptIds(newestFirst, max)` = newest 20 continuable ∪ newest 20 any). Tests: `runner/src/test/.../manifest/AttemptManifestWriterTest.scala`, `CostLogTest.scala` (pins `CostLogUsage` field list == `Usage`'s; keep that pin for the new usage type).
- `runner/src/main/scala/orca/flowEntry.scala`: `flow(...)` computes `runKey = RunKey.of(args.userPrompt)` (line ~158); `startTrace(dir, attemptId)` calls `OrcaLog.start(dir, attemptId)` then `OrcaBanner.print(System.err, orcaLog.file)`; `runAttempt` opens `supervised:` (a `BufferCapacity` given is needed for `Actor.create`; check how it is currently satisfied there), starts `AttemptManifestWriter`, adds it to `extraListeners`, and in `finally` calls `manifestWriter.finish(outcome)`; `runInContext` creates `SessionStore.default(workDir, runKey)` and hands it to `FlowLifecycle.setup(..., store, sessions, ...)` and `DefaultFlowControl`. `RunRequest` (`runner/.../RunRequest.scala`) is what `runFlow` receives; tests build it via `runner/src/test/.../FlowHarness.request` and `FlowLifecycleTest.runFlowForTest` (both inside `supervised`).
- `runner/src/main/scala/orca/runner/FlowLifecycle.scala`: `FlowSetup(store, sessionStore, featureBranch, ...)`; `setup(...)` takes `sessionStore: SessionStore`; `teardownSuccess(git, setup, published: PublishedState, emit)` runs `bestEffort("remove session records")(setup.sessionStore.discard())` after removing the progress log. `PublishedState.work: Option[PublishedWork]`, `PublishedWork(reference: String)` is the PR/MR reference for `RunSucceeded.published`. `setup.featureBranch.value` is the branch string.
- `runner/src/main/scala/orca/runner/OrcaLog.scala`: `start(workDir, id)` ensures `OrcaDir.ensureAttempts`, file `OrcaDir.traceLogPath(workDir, id)`, roll pattern `OrcaDir.traceLogRollPattern(workDir, id)`; `file: Option[os.Path]`. `OrcaBanner.print(out, logFile: Option[os.Path])` prints `Orca <version>, logs: <path>`; `OrcaBanner.version`. Test `runner/src/test/.../OrcaLogTest.scala` (lists `OrcaDir.attemptsPath` and asserts the rolled part maps to the attempt via `attemptIdOf`).
- `OrcaDir` members to retire: `ManifestSuffix`, `CostLogSuffix`, `sessionRecordsPath/File`, `attemptsPath`, `ensureAttempts`, `manifestPath/File`, `isManifest`, `costLogPath`; `traceLogPath(workDir, id)`/`traceLogRollPattern` move under the run dir; `attemptIdOf(file)` should recognise only `TraceLogSuffix`/`RolledTraceLogSuffix` at the end; `cacheRunsPath` is private today. `tools/src/test/scala/orca/OrcaDirTest.scala` tests all of these (lines ~139–209).
- Shell: `shell/src/main/scala/orca/shell/sessions/ManifestReader.scala` (`RecordedAttempt(id, manifest, observedStatus)`, `AttemptListing(attempts, warnings)`, `list(own, otherWorktrees, processAlive: AttemptManifest => Boolean)`: own dir read strictly with `assertNoOrcaSymlinks`, others guarded with one warning each, attempts with no sessions dropped, newest first by `startedAt`), `ObservedStatus.scala` (`of(manifest, processAlive)`, `processAlive(manifest)` uses `pid`+`startedAt` with 1-minute slack), `SessionSelection(ref, manifest, session, observedStatus)`, `SessionRef(attempt, position)` (1-based position in first-seen order), `SessionIndex.of(attempts)`, `SessionPicker`, `SessionNaming`, `ResumeCommand.staticGate/build(s: ManifestSession, ...)`, `shell/.../cli/Tables.scala` (`SessionRow` uses `SessionKind`, `stage: Option[String]`, `sessionStage: Option[StagePath]`), `cli/ContinueCli.runContinue(dirs, selector, list, json, tty, processAlive)`, `menu/ShellMenu.loop` (calls `ManifestReader.list` per redraw, `continueSessionCount = attempts.headOption.map(_.manifest.sessions.size)`, builds `SessionIndex.of(attempts)` eagerly), `actions/SessionAction` (`validatedWorkDir(selection.manifest.workDir)`), `WorktreeScan.lastAttemptAt` = mtime of `OrcaDir.attemptsPath`. Shell tests: `ManifestFixtures.scala` (builders + `writeManifest`), `ManifestReaderTest`, `ManifestRoundTripTest` (real writer → real reader), `SessionPickerTest`, `ObservedStatusTest`, `SessionActionTest`, `ResumeCommandTest`, `cli/CliTest` (~40 fixture uses; one test asserts a corrupt manifest's file name appears on stderr).
- Flow tests using `SessionStore.default(dir, key)` (all need a replacement): `TestRun.scala`, `pr/PrFakes.scala`, `SessionTest.scala` (`recordImplementer`, `inRun`, `records(dir)` model a second process reading records back), `FlowSessionTest.scala` (lines ~227–249, ~750–779 likewise), `StageRuntimeTest.scala:411`, `sessions/SessionStoreTest.scala` (delete), `review/ReviewAndFixTest.scala:2064`, `CommitMessageTest.scala:143` (plain `upsert` calls). Runner: `FlowLifecycleTest.scratchSessions()` and the test at ~line 462 that reads `sessions.records()` across two `runFlowForTest` calls over the same dir/prompt; the worktree test at ~164–174 asserts on `OrcaDir.attemptsPath`.

## Inputs the writer consumes
- `tools/src/main/scala/orca/events/OrcaEvent.scala`: `StageStarted(path: StagePath.Stage)`, `StageEnded(path, outcome: StageOutcome)`, `BranchBound(branch)`, `SessionCommitted(backend: BackendTag, clientId, wireId: Option[String], sessionKey: Option[SessionKey], agent, role)`, `TokensUsed(spend: UnpricedTurn, cost: Option[Cost])` with `UnpricedTurn(agent, model: Option[Model], usage: Usage, role, turn: Int, conversationKey)`; `OrcaEvent.conversationKey(clientId, wireId) = wireId.getOrElse(clientId)`. `StageOutcome` = Completed/Failed/Replayed. `Cost(amount: BigDecimal, basis: CostBasis)`, `CostBasis` = Reported | Estimated(ratesAsOf: LocalDate) (on the wire today `{"type":"Reported"}` / `{"type":"Estimated","ratesAsOf":...}` via nested derivation; keep). `Usage` fields: freshInputTokens, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheWriteInputTokens, outputTokens, reasoningOutputTokens, cost, apiCalls. `Model.name`.
- `StagePath` (`tools/.../StagePath.scala`): `given codec: JsonValueCodec[StagePath]` encodes as a JSON array of `{"name","occurrence"}` segments outermost first (`[]` = FlowBody); `.display` = `a#0/b#1`; `Stage.name`. This is the progress log's encoding the spec requires for every `stage` field. `SessionKey(name, stage: StagePath)` has `private[orca] given codec` (`tools/.../agents/SessionKey.scala`); `BackendTag.codec` encodes the case name. jsoniter supports `java.time.Instant` natively. `AttemptId` is an opaque type over String declared in `object AttemptId`; a `JsonValueCodec[AttemptId]` must be defined inside that object (string on the wire, `parse` on read, `decodeError` on mismatch).
- Listener contract (`OrcaListener` scaladoc, `EventDispatcher`): a throwing listener is quarantined for the rest of the run; an actor-backed listener uses `ask`; a throw inside a `tell` handler ends the actor's scope (the run). Hence "neither actor throws": wrap each actor method body in try/catch NonFatal → `LoggerFactory.getLogger("orca.flow").warn(...)` (pattern: `guarded` in `AttemptManifestWriterState`).
- Ox actors: `ox.channels.{Actor, ActorRef, BufferCapacity}`; `Actor.create(state)(using Ox, BufferCapacity)`; `ref.ask(_.f(...))` returns the result and propagates exceptions to the caller; `ref.tell(_.f(...))` is fire-and-forget. Draining the appender = an `ask(_ => ())` after the last `tell`, since one actor processes its mailbox in order. Pattern reference: `runner/.../terminal/TerminalActor.scala`. Test pattern: `supervised: given BufferCapacity = BufferCapacity(8); ...` (see `ManifestRoundTripTest`).
- jsoniter: `ConfiguredJsonValueCodec.derived[T](using CodecMakerConfig...)`; discriminator field defaults to `type`, set it explicitly `withDiscriminatorFieldName(Some("type"))`; nested enums reuse an implicit `JsonValueCodec` in scope, so give `StageOutcome` and `AttemptOutcome` string codecs (`withDiscriminatorFieldName(None)`, like `AttemptStatus.codec`) so `outcome` is a bare string while `CostBasis` stays an object. Do NOT use `JsonData.strictCodecConfig` (it rejects missing collection fields); default config skips unknown fields, which is what "readers ignore unknown fields" needs. Unknown `type` fails the line's decode → the reader skips it. `JsonFile` (`tools/.../util/JsonFile.scala`) is whole-file only; the event log needs its own line reader (`os.read.lines` or streaming), absent/unreadable → empty.
- Test fixtures: `orca.testkit.TempDirs.dir()`, `orca.testkit.StageEvents.started(name)/ended(name)` (tools test sources), `orca.testkit.GitRepo.seeded()`.

## Target layout (decisions; keep them so tasks converge)
- New package `orca.runlog` in the `flow` module (`flow/src/main/scala/orca/runlog/`), `private[orca]` unless a type must be public:
  - `RunEvent.scala`: `enum RunEvent(at: Instant, attempt: AttemptId)` with cases exactly as the spec's table: `AttemptStarted(schema: Int, orcaVersion, flow: Option[String], workDir: String, pid: Long, trace: Option[String])`, `BranchBound(branch)`, `StageStarted(stage: StagePath.Stage)`, `StageEnded(stage, outcome: StageOutcome)`, `SessionMinted(name, stage: StagePath, id, seed, backend)`, `SessionWireId(id, wireId)`, `SessionCommitted(backend, wireId: Option[String], conversationKey, agent, role: Option[String], minted: Option[SessionKey], stage: Option[StagePath.Stage])`, `Turn(agent, role, model: Option[String], stage: Option[StagePath.Stage], turn: Int, apiCalls: Option[Long], usage: TurnUsage, cost: Option[Cost], conversationKey)`, `RunSucceeded(branch, published: Option[String])`, `AttemptFinished(outcome: AttemptOutcome)`. `RunEvent.Schema: Int = 1`. `AttemptOutcome` (Succeeded/Failed) moves here from `orca.runner.manifest`. `TurnUsage` = today's `CostLogUsage` (move + rename; keep the `Usage` field-list pin test). Companion: `given codec: JsonValueCodec[RunEvent]`, `encodeLine(e): String` (no newline), `decodeLine(s): Either[String, RunEvent]`.
  - `RunEventReader.scala`: `read(path): List[RunEvent]` (skips lines that do not decode; absent/unreadable → Nil) and a cheap `readOnly(path, types)` or `readWhere` for the menu that avoids fully decoding other lines (e.g. decode a `{"type": ...}`-only shape first).
  - `SessionProjection.scala`: pure `records(events: List[RunEvent]): List[SessionRecord]` — events after the last `RunSucceeded`; `SessionMinted` appends/replaces by `SessionKey`; `SessionWireId(id, wireId)` sets `resumeWireId` on the record with that `id`; mint order preserved.
  - `RunPruning.scala`: `pruneRuns(cacheRuns: os.Path, current: RunKey)` and `pruneTraces(runDir: os.Path)` per the spec's Pruning section (`MaxKept = 20`; protected = any `SessionMinted` after the last `RunSucceeded`; "recorded a session" = any `SessionMinted`; order by `events.jsonl` mtime; each delete guarded); `removeLegacy(cache: os.Path)` deletes `attempts/` recursively and `runs/*.sessions.json`.
  - `RunEventLog.scala`: `trait RunEventLog extends OrcaListener, SessionStore` adding `finish(outcome: AttemptOutcome): Unit` and `runSucceeded(branch: String, published: Option[String]): Unit`; `object RunEventLog.start(workDir, runKey, attemptId, orcaVersion, flowName: Option[String], tracePath: Option[os.Path], clock: () => Instant)(using Ox, BufferCapacity): RunEventLog`. Start order: `OrcaDir.ensureRunDir`, `removeLegacy`, `pruneRuns`, `pruneTraces`, load projection from the file, write `AttemptStarted`. Projection actor: one `private var state: Projection` (immutable case class: session records, open stage stack `List[StagePath.Stage]`, attemptId, clock); every `onEvent`, `records()`, `upsert`, `runSucceeded`, `finish` is an `ask` that updates state, then `appender.tell(_.append(event))`. `upsert(record)`: no record with that key → `SessionMinted` (plus `SessionWireId` if `resumeWireId` is set); record exists and `resumeWireId` differs → `SessionWireId`; identical → nothing. `onEvent` maps `StageStarted/StageEnded/BranchBound/SessionCommitted/TokensUsed` and ignores the rest; `SessionCommitted.stage`/`Turn.stage` = innermost open stage. `finish` writes `AttemptFinished` then `appender.ask(_ => ())`. Appender actor: `os.write.append(eventLogPath, line + "\n")`, guarded. Nothing in either actor may throw.
- `SessionStore` (flow) becomes: `records(): List[SessionRecord]`; `upsert(record: SessionRecord): Unit`; no `path`, no `discard`, no `default`; scaladoc rewritten to describe the projection. `Session.scala` drops the self-minted `WorkspaceWrite` in `mintSession` and the `ws` parameter in `persistResumeWireId` (its callers' `using WorkspaceWrite` on `FlowSession.run`/`FlowSessionCall.run` stay: those are LLM turns on the flow thread).
- `OrcaDir` additions: `cacheRunsPath(workDir)` (public, passive), `runDirPath(workDir, key)`, `ensureRunDir(workDir, key)`, `EventLogName = "events.jsonl"`, `eventLogPath(workDir, key)`, `traceLogPath(workDir, key, id)`, `traceLogRollPattern(workDir, key, id)`.
- `OrcaLog.start(workDir, key, id)`; `OrcaBanner.print(out, progress: os.Path, events: os.Path, trace: Option[os.Path])` printing the spec's four lines (`(trace file unavailable)` when `None`).
- Wiring: `RunRequest` gains `runLog: RunEventLog`; `runFlow` appends it to the dispatcher's listeners beside `LoggingListener` (so a caller cannot forget it) and `runInContext` passes it as the `SessionStore` to `FlowLifecycle.setup` and `DefaultFlowControl`; `FlowSetup.sessionStore` becomes `runLog: RunEventLog`; `teardownSuccess` calls `setup.runLog.runSucceeded(setup.featureBranch.value, published.work.map(_.reference))` where `discard()` was. `flow()` starts it in `runAttempt` after `startTrace` (needs `orcaLog.file`) and calls `finish(outcome)` in the `finally`.
- Flow test double: `flow/src/test/scala/orca/sessions/TestSessionStore.scala`, in-memory (`AtomicReference[List[SessionRecord]]` updated by a pure upsert), for `TestRun`, `PrFakes`, `StageRuntimeTest`; tests that model a second process (SessionTest, FlowSessionTest, FlowLifecycleTest) use the real `RunEventLog.start` in a `supervised` scope and read back via `RunEventReader` + `SessionProjection` or a second `RunEventLog.start` after `finish`. If runner tests need the in-memory double, add `flow % "test->test"` to runner's `dependsOn` in build.sbt.
- Shell: `ManifestReader` → `EventLogReader` in `orca.shell.sessions` with the same `list(own, otherWorktrees, processAlive)` shape plus `newestSessionCount(own, otherWorktrees): Option[Int]` (spec "Menu redraw": files newest-first by mtime, only `AttemptStarted`+`SessionCommitted` lines, stop when the next file's mtime predates the kept attempt's `startedAt`). Per-attempt projection: `AttemptStarted` + `BranchBound` + `AttemptFinished`; sessions from `SessionCommitted` deduplicated by `(backend, conversationKey)` in first-seen order; a session's `stage` (render as the innermost stage's `name`, as today) and `lastActiveAt` (= that event's `at`) come from its latest `SessionCommitted`; `minted` kept once seen; status Running/Succeeded/Failed from `AttemptFinished`, Crashed when absent and the pid is dead (`ObservedStatus`). Event logs are read from `OrcaDir.cacheRunsPath(dir)/*/events.jsonl` across own + worktrees; attempts with no sessions are dropped. Final shell-side types: `AttemptRecord` (today's `AttemptManifest` fields minus `continuable`, no codec), `RecordedSession` (today's `ManifestSession`), `SessionKind`, `AttemptStatus` all in `orca.shell.sessions`; `SessionSelection.manifest` → `attempt`.

findings.title: Trace-log disk use is no longer bounded: resumable runs keep all their traces forever, and kept runs keep 20 attempts' traces each

reason.text: The authoritative spec (docs/plans/run-event-log/specification.md, Pruning) explicitly prunes traces "in the current run's directory only" and deletes whole run directories, never a resumable one. Pruning traces in other runs would change a recorded design decision. The trace-footprint trade-off is a fair point, but it should go to the user as a spec change, not in a scoped fix.

resultJson.title: Implement run event log per ADR 0025
resultJson.body:
Replace orca's three cache files per run (`sessions.json`, attempt manifest, cost log) with one append-only JSONL event log (`.orca/cache/runs/<key>/events.jsonl`), and move trace logs to the run directory. This closes #290 by giving external tools a stable, public way to read a run's cost and state from one file.

The event log is the run's new source of truth for session records and attempt metadata. Writing is actor-based (projection actor + appender actor, neither throws). Reading folds the events to rebuild session records and attempt listings. At success, the run appends `RunSucceeded` instead of deleting the records, so later runs of the same prompt reuse those sessions. Pruning works on run directories: keep the newest 20 with sessions, plus the newest 20 of any kind, and never a run with unfinished sessions.

The committed progress log is unchanged. Trace logs now live beside the event log in the run directory. Old manifest and cost-log files are deleted on the first attempt of the new version. The event format is documented and public: changes within one schema number are additive only.

Updated AGENTS.md (persisted-state table, vocabulary, session-record location), the developer glossary, and docs/using/output-and-files.md with the event table and jq cost example. Added amendments to ADR 0018 and ADR 0021 pointing to the new ADR 0025, which is Accepted. Code comments and scaladocs updated to name the event log instead of the old files.
